summary_en: This Phase 1/2 study tests tegavivint (BC2059), a TBL1 inhibitor, alone and combined with lenvatinib or cabozantinib, in adults with advanced hepatocellular carcinoma. Tegavivint is given weekly on days 1, 8, 15, and 22 of a 28-day cycle, and lenvatinib and cabozantinib are given once daily on days 1 to 28 of each cycle. The record does not state the main outcome measure; the study is described as Phase 1/2.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/2 evalúa tegavivint (BC2059), un inhibidor de TBL1, solo y combinado con lenvatinib o cabozantinib, en adultos con carcinoma hepatocelular avanzado. El tegavivint se administra semanalmente los días 1, 8, 15 y 22 de un ciclo de 28 días, y el lenvatinib y el cabozantinib se administran una vez al día los días 1 al 28 de cada ciclo. El registro no indica la medida principal de resultado; el estudio se describe como de fase 1/2.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with advanced hepatocellular carcinoma.
Barcelona Clinic Liver Cancer stage C, or stage B not suitable for locoregional or curative treatment.
Progression, intolerance, or contraindication to at least one prior line of systemic therapy.
Measurable disease by RECIST 1.1 on CT or MRI.
ECOG performance status 0 or 1, and Child-Pugh class A or B (score 7 or less) without hepatic encephalopathy.
not_for: Known fibrolamellar, sarcomatoid, or mixed cholangiocarcinoma and HCC.
Currently receiving other anticancer or experimental agents.
Known Gilbert's syndrome or other genetic conditions affecting UGT1A1 function.
Clinically significant heart disease or baseline QTc (Fridericia) of 450 ms or more.
